requirements.evidence: Two irrigation runs: run-1 connects 0,-1 to 1,-1, run-2 connects 0,0 to 1,0 - both at level 0 irrigation mode, threading through each base. Bins placed are shallow third-depth compatible with pipe-through cells (hex-bin-third). All cells contain soil and plants demonstrating fed cells.

finish.summary: Built 4-cell planter (diamond of 4 full hex bases) with irrigation pipe network covering all cells via two runs (0,-1↔1,-1 and 0,0↔1,0). Each cell holds a third-depth bin with soil and cabbage plant; open faces capped and joints locked.

lines.key: 3/4in FLEXIBLE PVC (IPS, glues into Sch 40 with Weld-On 795), 147 mm over 1 corner
lines.label: 3/4in FLEXIBLE PVC (IPS, glues into Sch 40 with Weld-On 795), 147 mm over 1 corner
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: 2 runs IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.

Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
buy 1 x 25 ft 3/4 in FLEXIBLE PVC, IPS, OD 26.67 mm (US), glues into Sch 40 sockets
- flexible legs are pool/spa grade hose: irrigation only, NOT potable and not for indoor plumbing
- glue with Weld-On 795 flexible-PVC cement and P-68/P-70 primer, not ordinary rigid cement
- keep every bend clear of its glued socket: the joint fails long before the pipe does
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
